A dependency-free .NET 8 document exporter: describe a document once (headings, paragraphs, tables, pictures) and write it as Word (.docx), Excel (.xlsx), PowerPoint (.pptx), PDF or HTML. Every format is written from its specification with what .NET has; no packages, no Office installed.
Build-time WPF XAML markup compiler for the Gtk4.Wpf compatibility layer.

Meta-package: add one PackageReference to run an existing WPF app on GTK 4 without editing controls, XAML, usings or namespaces. The package rewrites the consumer .csproj and pulls in the Gtk4.Wpf WPF compatibility layer.
